subject: HaloHealth: Next steps for security questionnaire & SOC 2 / BAA clarifications
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@halohealth.com>, Jacob Price <jacob.price@halohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: HaloHealth: Next steps for security questionnaire & SOC 2 / BAA clarifications

Hi Elena / Jacob —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and requested next steps so we stay aligned on the vendor security intake: 

Summary / asks from Redwood:
- We will support a SIG/CAIQ prefill to speed your intake team. I attached a prefill XLS (redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx) with high-level answers for common fields. Please confirm any fields you edit.
- Question on SOC 2: we maintain a SOC 2 Type II that covers our core inference platform (control environment, change management, incident response, encryption/keys). Can you confirm whether you need the full SOC 2 report or a SOC 2 summary + SOC 2 attestation letter is sufficient for initial approval?
- GDPR / Data residency: HaloHealth asked about EU data handling. For clarification: Redwood stores customer data in region-specific clusters when configured; by default hosted customers in our US region are stored in US. If you require EU processing, we can route to our eu region under a DPA. Please confirm required residency.
- HIPAA / BAA: you mentioned potential PHI scope. We are open to a BAA for covered workloads. To scope the BAA, can you confirm the expected data flows (what type of PHI will be sent, who are the Redwood users, and whether you will use logging/audit requirements)?
- Evidence asks: typical evidence requests we see are network diagrams, encryption config (at-rest and in-transit), access control matrix, and recent vulnerability scan summaries. If you can share the SIG/CAIQ questionnaire now we will prefill the answers and pull the evidence pack.

Proposed timeline / owners:
- HaloHealth completes shared SIG/CAIQ file or confirms the specific format you want (CAIQ XLS / your custom form): target 5 business days.
- Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary + evidence examples within 48 hours of your confirmation.
- If a BAA is required, bring procurement contact into thread and we can loop Legal (Marissa) for redlines.

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx (prefill), example evidence filenames referenced below.

Open questions for you (please reply inline):
1) Will you accept SOC 2 summary + attestation or need the full report right away?
2) Confirm EU data residency requirement (yes/no) and which EU region (if yes).
3) Do you need a BAA / is PHI in-scope today? If yes, who is HaloHealth procurement contact?
4) Any mandatory formatting for the SIG/CAIQ (we can do CAIQ XLS, CAIQ JSON, or your custom form).

Happy to jump on a 30-min follow up if that makes moving paperwork faster. Thanks — we want to make this as frictionless as possible.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0122
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Elena Morales <elena@halohealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jacob Price <jacob.price@halohealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HaloHealth: Next steps for security questionnaire & SOC 2 / BAA clarifications

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers and a few clarifying notes from our side: 

1) SOC 2: For procurement stage, a SOC 2 summary + attestation letter is usually fine. If legal requests full report later, we will request it through the secure channel. Please include the date range covered by the Type II report in the summary.

2) EU Residency: HaloHealth is US-headquartered but we process some EU patient data. For this initial procurement we need confirmation we can opt into an EU processing region (EU data centers), and we will require a DPA.

3) BAA / PHI: We do plan to send PHI-related content for the integration test and potentially production. A BAA will be required before production data is sent. For now, scope the conversation as: test phase (no PHI), production (PHI). Procurement will need to see redlineable BAA template. Procurement contact: procurement@halohealth.com (cc not in this reply).

4) SIG / CAIQ format: We can accept CAIQ XLS or the standard Consensus SIG format. I can attach our intake spreadsheet to this thread — I will ask Jacob to upload. Timeline: we expect to complete initial review once we have prefilled answers + evidence; target 5 business days after we receive the workbook and evidence.

Can you provide the SOC 2 summary and a link to the secure portal for full reports (if requested)? Also please include a sample network diagram and a sample access control matrix for our security team to review.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of IT Security, HaloHealth
elena@halohealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

---
Attachment: halo_internal_intake_template.xlsx (will follow from Jacob)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@halohealth.com>, Jacob Price <jacob.price@halohealth.com>, procurement@halohealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HaloHealth: Next steps for security questionnaire & SOC 2 / BAA clarifications

Thanks Elena — this is perfect and very actionable. Quick confirmations and we’ll execute: 

- SOC 2: We will send the SOC 2 Type II summary and attestation cover letter (date range: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) as redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (attached). If your legal team needs the full report later we can provide a secure download link via our vendor portal; I included the HubSpot reference for tracking.

- EU data residency: Confirmed — Redwood can route customer workloads to our EU region under a DPA. Marissa (cc) will start the DPA/BAA conversation once procurement confirms scope.

- BAA: Noted that production will require a BAA. Marissa (Legal) will reach out to procurement@halohealth.com with our standard BAA template and next steps for redlines.

- Evidence: attaching a short evidence examples pack (vendor-evidence-examples.pdf) that includes a sample network diagram and an access-control matrix sample. If you want a deeper packet (vulnerability scan reports, pen test summaries) we can pull that after the CAIQ is accepted.

Next steps (action items):
1) HaloHealth: Share the completed CAIQ/consensus SIG file or your custom intake template (Jacob / procurement). Target: within 5 business days.
2) Redwood (Ben / Soojin): We will provide SOC 2 summary + evidence examples within 24-48 hours of receipt of confirmation (attached).
3) HaloHealth procurement: loop in procurement@halohealth.com to start BAA and DPA redlines.

If it helps, Ben can schedule a short working session with your security intake team to walk through the prefill (30-45 minutes). Are mornings best for you next week (Tue/Wed)?

Thanks — we’ll prioritize this.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0122
